examples.trans: They have to be washed carefully by hand.
Put the glasses carefully on the table.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.trans: Look at the camera's video recording.
The video recording is saved on the drive.

meanings.note: pointing at something a little way off
вон отсюда! = get out of here!

вставать.gloss: to get up, to stand up

meanings.note: out of bed or from the floor

examples.trans: Come on, Tuzik, let's get up!
I get up at seven in the morning.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

meanings.en: far, far away, a long way

examples.trans: The shop is far from the house.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: А он вон какой душегуб оказался!
examples.trans: And turns out he is quite a murderer!

examples.text: В старых сказках часто упоминается душегуб.
examples.trans: In old fairy tales a murderer is often mentioned.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: Cutting a living person with a knife!
You can't torture a living person like that!

зайти.gloss: to come in, to drop in

meanings.en: to come in, to step in

examples.trans: I'll drop by in the evening.
This is the law of the country.

зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least

examples.text: Четыре по алгебре, зато по физкультуре пятёрка.
examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
The flat is small, but at least it's in the centre.

examples.text: Ну злодеи они там все, конечно!
examples.trans: Well, they are all villains in there, of course!
At the end of the film they caught the villain.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: The investigators prepared a multi-step operation.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

насколько.gloss: how much, to what extent, as far as

meanings.note: in expressions like насколько я знаю / насколько нам известно

examples.text: Насколько нам известно, она закрыла долг.
examples.trans: As far as we know, she paid off the debt.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

оказаться.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be

examples.trans: You turned out to be ungrateful.

examples.text: Он внезапно оказался в центре событий.
examples.trans: He suddenly found himself in the center of events.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

повезти.gloss: to be lucky (impersonal); to take (by vehicle)

meanings.note: impersonal, + dative: мне повезло = I was lucky; повезло! = what luck!

examples.trans: You are a despicable man, Borya!

meanings.en: corpus delicti, red-handed evidence; с поличным = red-handed

examples.text: Все улики и поличное приобщены к делу.
examples.trans: All evidence and goods were added to the case.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: to sit down, to take a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on a chair.
The investigation continues in full swing.
The investigation gathered all important facts.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: In prison it will be much worse.

meanings.note: having a moderate degree of heat

examples.trans: And where are your warm gloves?

укутать.gloss: to wrap up warmly, bundle up

meanings.en: to wrap warmly in clothing or blankets

examples.text: Срочно укутайте его в тёплые вещи.
examples.trans: Wrap him in warm clothes immediately.

examples.text: Мать тепло укутала ребёнка перед прогулкой.
examples.trans: The mother bundled the child up warmly before the walk.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down

examples.text: Меня чуть не утопили в проруби.
examples.trans: They almost drowned me in the ice hole.

examples.text: Он случайно утопил ключи в реке.
examples.trans: He accidentally drowned his keys in the river.

meanings.note: чуть не + verb: я чуть не упал = I nearly fell

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
